honesty: getTokenSupply on a mint account is the issued supply of that mint. It is not circulating supply, not a reserve attestation, not backing and not a grade. Identification is weaker than on the EVM side: an SPL mint carries no symbol() to call, so every row is marked UNCONFIRMED_ONCHAIN and the mint-to-symbol mapping rests on the aggregator alone.
